title: Update a copy: add a service description and retain earlier data
goal: Add an optional text service description in a restored copy and verify old requests, the new field and recovery.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: Platform and solution updates differ
paragraphs: A new executable platform version and a new configuration are different changes. Record both versions, compatibility mode and purpose before and after. Do not blame every error on “old 1C” without reproduction. Start with one configuration change on the same platform to avoid mixing two factors.

Only the configuration changes, on the same platform. Add service УчебноеОписание: String(100), optional. This does not rename Наименование. Keep the A4 customer note and A5 table. Do not load a full new CF over customized work.

sections.title: An additive change
paragraphs: Check the added feature together with previous scenarios.

code.source:
Услуги: + УчебноеОписание, String(100), optional
Older requests:30/45 →75 before and after
code.output: Existing fields/references remain while the new description persists separately.

sections.title: A control dataset protects meaning
paragraphs: Prepare an old request, a new request, zero duration and rejected input. Reconcile report and references before upgrading. Repeat the same set afterwards and add the new capability’s scenario. Opening the main window is insufficient: lost fields or broken filters may appear only when old data is read.

Record service codes and control-request references/numbers/minutes30/45. Preserve the source and DT. Add one attribute, save configuration, then apply it to the database. The change list must match the new service field; unexpected removals require stopping before application.

sections.title: Verify return beforehand
paragraphs: Back up before changing and verify restoration separately. Once an upgrade changes data, replacing the executable alone need not restore earlier state. Keep source and upgraded copies with distinct paths and identities. Preserve failed copies until the cause and safe protocol have been recorded.

The old service’s new field starts empty. Write Учебная проверка A6 and reopen. Earlier references and 75 should remain. If using the already changed 90-minute copy, explicitly record 90 as its baseline; comparing different initial states does not establish update preservation.

sections.title: Unexpected removal in the change list
paragraphs: A successful launch cannot compensate for lost structure.

code.source: Expected a new description; an old field is marked for removal.
code.output: Stop application and compare source with the proposed change.

sections.title: Apply based on results
paragraphs: The summary lists passed, failed and untested workflows plus rollback. Untested exchange or permissions do not inherit PASS from unrelated checks. The teaching task delivers a tested candidate rather than publishing it. Real working-system changes require their owner and an agreed maintenance window even after successful tests.

Prepare recovery before modifying: retained source and a verified DT. Loading an earlier CF does not guarantee reverting data after structural changes. Open the preserved source or restore its DT into another new base and compare controls. This exercise authorizes no production publication.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Platform upgrading is conflated with adding one field. Record both versions and change one factor per experiment.
The description replaces a populated field’s name/type. Add a distinct optional attribute while retaining prior structure.
An older CF is treated as guaranteed data rollback. Verify an earlier DT restore in another base and compare values.

selfcheck.feedback: The change must match the intended scope.
A new interface alone does not establish preservation.

selfcheck.prompt: Verify a separate pre-change restore and explain CF-only rollback limits.
selfcheck.feedback: Recovery is supported by data comparisons, not old source alone.

practice.title: One new field, earlier references and controls retained
practice.task: Verify a separate pre-change restore and explain CF-only rollback limits.
practice.environment: Own original service desk; synthetic records only. No real Nexus accounts, Windows identities or external services are changed.
practice.externalRoute: Official installed 1C Enterprise/Designer of your own separate training copy

steps.title: Record versions and controls
steps.action: Use a freshly restored 30/45=75 copy from the DT before the previous edit. Record versions/path/control keys and retain the source.
steps.why: Avoid conflating update with the earlier 90-minute edit.
steps.troubleshooting: If using 90, explicitly retain 90 as the baseline and compare it consistently.
steps.before: Earlier A5 work/provenance and a verified separate-copy route are retained.

steps.title: Add the service description
steps.where: Copy Designer → Catalogs → Услуги → Data → Attributes
steps.action: Add УчебноеОписание: String, length 100, no fill check. Keep earlier names/types/objects.
steps.why: The added field must not replace the model.
steps.troubleshooting: If your earlier attempt already added it, inspect rather than duplicate.

steps.title: Apply the expected change only
steps.action: Review changes and update only the copy. Stop for removals or unrelated objects.
steps.why: Separate metadata saving from database application.
steps.expected: Field added without deleting prior structure.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not confirm an unexpected list merely to continue.

steps.title: Write the new value and reread older data
steps.where: Copy Enterprise → Услуги and control requests
steps.action: Find the old service’s empty description, write Учебная проверка A6, save and reopen. Compare service code, requests 30/45, total 75 and retained customer note.
steps.why: Test the added feature and older data separately.
steps.troubleshooting: An explicit custom form may need the field element; modify only a form copy following module 5.
steps.before: Field added without deleting prior structure.

steps.title: Demonstrate recovery
steps.where: Preserved source or a new base restored from the earlier DT
steps.action: Open the original path or restore the earlier DT into another empty base and compare pre-change controls. Keep the updated copy.
steps.expected: Pre-change state is accessible and new work retained.
steps.troubleshooting: Preserve the failed/successful copy and result before any cleanup.

criteria: The two update kinds are distinguished.
One new attribute, retained identities/duration and persisted text.
Recovery is supported by data comparisons, not old source alone.
Actual versions and distinct own-copy paths; synthetic identities and before/after values.
Allowed/refused cases, completed controls and explicit untested scope; no secrets.
Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.
